answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks mass forgery: each agent locks a 70-credit bond and files its work rhythm in the open ocean ledger. A cipher seals each fingerprint to its key. Each epoch a comet sweep replays one random slice; a copied, rented, or mistimed sequence burns the bond. First fake 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented fingerprints bear another key; an honest agent pays 40 once.
